title: Spotted lanternfly's estimated annual economic cost to Pennsylvania

source.name: Economic Impact of the Spotted Lanternfly on the Pennsylvania Economy (2019)
source.publisher: Penn State College of Agricultural Sciences, Center for Economic and Community Development

notes: The 2019 Penn State study found then-current damage of about $50.1 million/year (484 jobs) concentrated in southeastern PA, projected to reach at least $324 million/year (2,800 jobs) statewide if the pest is left unchecked, and up to a worst-case $554 million/year (nearly 5,000 jobs) if damage reaches the maximum projected by crop and forestry experts.
